name: smwgraphics-plok-acrillic-garden-beach
title: Plok - Acrillic Garden Beach
description:
Great beach background from Plok. This uses BG1 & BG2, so you'll need LM 1.7x to use it. Takes one palette row, sample level included.
Since this background isn't scrollable, you'll have to set the Layer 2 scrolling to none/none.

Credit isn't necessary.
